description: Department of Local Government - Western Province - Notify the details of Mayors, Deputy Mayors and Chairmen of Colombo, Gampaha and Kalutara Districts
reasoning: This gazette contains announcements of election results and appointments of elected officials (Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen, and Deputy Chairmen) for local government authorities following the 2018 Local Government Authorities Elections. It specifically operates under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendments, making it clearly related to electoral processes and outcomes.
